# Guilherme Rodovalho — Software Architect & Staff Software Engineer

> High-performance software engineering platform, autonomous WebMCP browser agent, real-time RUM performance observatory, and ATS career system.

Guilherme Rodovalho is a Software Architect and Staff Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience building mission-critical distributed systems, high-throughput frontend architectures, and autonomous AI agents. His track record includes engineering platforms sustaining 150,000 requests/minute during Black Friday (Casas Bahia), serving 35M+ users globally (Hotmart), and architecting resilient financial micro-frontends (Cielo & Zup Innovation / Itaú).

## Core Capabilities & Specializations

- **Software Architecture**: Clean Architecture, Modular Monoliths, Micro-frontends, Event-Driven Architecture, SOLID, Design Patterns.
- **Frontend & Web Engineering**: Next.js 14 (App Router, React Server Components, Streaming SSR), TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, Web Vitals Optimization (LCP 4.2s -> 1.4s at Casas Bahia).
- **AI & Agentic Systems**: Model Context Protocol (WebMCP in-browser), Google Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini Nano (window.ai on-device), Deterministic Grounding RAG.
- **Performance & Observability**: Real User Monitoring (RUM) via native browser APIs (PerformanceNavigationTiming, PerformanceObserver), zero-SDK overhead.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL APIs, Serverless, Edge Functions, Resend transactional email, Docker, CI/CD.

## In-Browser WebMCP (Model Context Protocol)

The platform implements an in-browser MCP agent server (`apps/web/src/lib/mcp/server.ts`) exposing semantic DOM tools for AI assistants:
- `navigate_to`: Programmatic client-side navigation between portfolio sections.
- `scroll_to_section`: Smooth scrolling to specific element IDs (`#experience`, `#projects`, `#skills`).
- `highlight_element`: Canvas-based visual element spotlight and pulse animation.
- `adjust_font_size`: Dynamic WCAG accessibility font scaling (`small`, `normal`, `large`) via root CSS variables.
- `trigger_resume_download`: Automated ATS PDF resume generation and download.

## API Endpoints

- `POST /api/chat`: AI Career Assistant streaming endpoint with multi-tier fallback (Gemini 3.8 Flash -> Gemini Nano -> Heuristic Engine).
- `POST /api/contact`: Transactional contact email delivery via Resend API (`rodovalhogdeveloper@gmail.com`).
- `POST /api/job-application`: Automated ATS job description analyzer and cover letter generator.
- `GET /api/resume?lang=pt-BR|en-US`: Dynamic ATS vector PDF resume generator via `pdf-lib`.
